query:
SELECT 
  m1.attendeeId,
  m1.timeSlot,
  COUNT(*) as clash_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m1.sponsorId ORDER BY m1.sponsorId SEPARATOR ', ') as sponsor_ids
FROM meetings m1
GROUP BY m1.attendeeId, m1.timeSlot
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY m1.attendeeId, m1.timeSlot;
